pattern.short_summary: The user hands a whole multi-step task to the system through a non-visual act and then stops attending to it; there is no display at any point in the loop.
pattern.definition: The user hands a whole multi-step task to the system through a non-visual act and then stops attending to it; there is no display at any point in the loop. Nothing is shown during execution, and the user cannot inspect progress. The handoff is complete at the moment of the request.
pattern.structural_signature: The interaction consists of an initiation gesture, a specification uttered on a non-visual channel, and a terminating signal, with no display surface in the loop and no intermediate state exposed. Structurally this forbids monitoring, mid-flight correction, and selection among alternatives: the control flow has exactly one user decision point, at the start. Transplants to any delegation without a display — a button on a wearable, a voice command to an appliance.

dimension.category_description: How interaction crosses sensory, physical, spatial, embodied, or representational channels.
dimension.classification_boundary: The channel, embodiment, or rendering must be the load-bearing interface mechanism.

candidates.title: AI at your Fingertips: Wearable Ring as a Low-Friction Interface for Agentic AI

evidence.quote: We present a technology probe designed to explore the experience of screenless, “fire-and-forget” task delegation.
